connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

imageTag.title: Image tag
imageTag.description: Console image tag. Set explicitly so the deployed image is pinned rather than following the chart appVersion.

host.title: Host
host.description: Console host. Defaults to okdp-ui.<ingress suffix>.

oidcAuthority.title: OIDC authority
oidcAuthority.description: Issuer the console redirects to, injected at container start rather than baked into the bundle. Defaults to the platform issuer (global.okdp.oidc.issuerUri).

oidcClientId.title: OIDC client ID
oidcClientId.description: Defaults to the platform client (global.okdp.oidc.clientId), else okdp-ui.

rolesClaim.title: Roles claim
rolesClaim.description: Claim of the ID token carrying the caller's roles. Dotted paths are resolved. Keycloak keeps realm_access out of the ID token, hence groups.

adminRole.title: Admin role
adminRole.description: Role that opens the administration screens.

backendService.title: Backend service
backendService.description: In-cluster Service the ingress routes /api to. Defaults to the server release of the same platform: this release name with okdp-control-plane-ui replaced by okdp-control-plane-server.
